title: Integral stratified perfect closure under degree zero cohomology
statement: theorem integralStratifiedPerfectClosure_homology (T : Scheme.{u}) (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E] [IsNoetherian T] (_hdim : ∃ n : ℕ, topologicalKrullDim T ≤ n) (_hl : IsUnit (l : Γ(T, ⊤))) (K : PbcCompletedDerived T (pbcIntegralDatum l E)) (hK : PbcIsBoundedConstructibleComplete T (pbcIntegralDatum l E) K) (q : ℤ) : PbcIsBoundedConstructibleComplete T (pbcIntegralDatum l E) ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj K))

proof.text: Map the global unit condition for l into every stalk and apply pbcIntegralUniformComplete_isTriangulated for the lifted integral coefficient datum. Register its isomorphism closure and triangulation, hence closure under every integer shift.

Apply the truncation clause of integralStratifiedPerfectClosure first to K at q, obtaining L = tauLE(q) K in the category, and then to L at q, obtaining M = tauGE(q) L in the category. Standard truncation bounds put M in the shifted heart [q,q].

The standard derived-category shifted-heart equivalence supplies Y and e : M isomorphic to single_q(Y). The canonical maps tauLE(q) K to K and L to tauGE(q) L induce isomorphisms on H^q: use truncLEIsoTruncLT and the proved source-library isIso_homologyFunctor_map_truncLTι_app and isIso_homologyFunctor_map_truncGEπ_app. Compose these with H^q(e) and singleFunctorCompHomologyFunctorIso to identify Y with H^q(K). Shift e by q, use singleFunctors.shiftIso q 0 q, and apply singleFunctor_0 to this last identification. This gives M[q] isomorphic to single_0(H^q(K)). Shift closure and isomorphism closure now prove the conclusion. The source-library truncation isomorphisms are already proved from the long cohomology sequence, without using this item or its parent.
